generator: SplitMix64; rejection-sampled uniform index; ordered bring4 without replacement
team_distribution: Independent uniform draw from four frozen teams for each side, with replacement (mirrors allowed). Not metagame-weighted.
initial_state_and_actions: Binary --describe freezes a weighted initial outcome after sorting complete Debug state, then samples uniformly from each side legal Move joints including Mega and target variants. No strategic pruning; no switches/pass.
sample_seed_policy: Five predeclared independent seeds per opening; each reused at N=16,64,256 (prefix-coupled budgets). Repeats are not additional openings.
defaults: Preserve source team bytes. Omitted IVs/genders/base abilities and normalized Mega forms remain documented simulation assumptions in per-team metadata; not newly verified public facts.
paper_comparison: Methodology-inspired internal R1 probe. Not the paper M-B corpus, outcome schema, hardware or Pokai implementation; no direct speed ratio.
